name: The Basics of American Government (UNG Press)
goodFor: A concise introductory American national government textbook from a university press.

evidence.quote: Please note that this textbook is under a CC BY-ND (NoDerivs) license.
This means that the text can be shared in its original version, but any remixes or revisions by other authors cannot be shared.

Newly revised to include results from the 2024 election, The Basics of American Government offers a comprehensive overview of the American political system for students taking introductory courses in American national government

notes: Link only. The only licence statement found is on the Affordable Learning Georgia repository page for the 2017 edition (the University System of Georgia's own repository): CC BY-ND (NoDerivs), with no version given, so the SPDX id is recorded as unknown. NoDerivatives forbids shared adaptations, so Ceder cannot show shortened or changed extracts. The press's own page for the current fifth edition (352 pages, revised for the 2024 election) states no licence at all, so the licence of that edition is not confirmed; the Galileo page describes a different, 470-page edition. Authors' terms for the online companion were not read.
